transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I was advised to come in because of an ongoing situation at my building. It's been happening for months now. I prefer to keep my private affairs to myself, but... the short of it is that the property manager and certain people in the building are trying to pressure me out of my apartment. 

It’s just... things like constantly misdelivered mail. Timed noises in the walls. Little comments from the neighbors when I walk by. They try to brush it all off with paperwork and various explanations, but I analyze data for a living. No amount of their excuses changes the pattern I can clearly see.
Have you felt this way, that other people are trying to undermine or get at you, for as long as you can remember?

No. ... Not at all. It's not a lifelong issue, if that's what you're implying. 

It's specific to this building. I'd say it's been going on for... about 11 months. Just shortly after I moved into the new apartment. I didn't have these kinds of problems before that.
Do you think there is any chance that your neighbors’ behavior is just coincidental or explainable in a normal way?

No. ... I thought I made that clear. It's not a coincidence. 

You don't just have mail constantly misdirected, or... or noises perfectly timed in the walls by chance. The property manager and those people are doing it to pressure me out of the apartment. I've looked at the data. I don't care how many normal explanations or... or pieces of paperwork they try to hide behind. It doesn't change the pattern. I know what I'm seeing.
Have you ever heard voices that other people could not hear?

No. I haven't. 

I'm just dealing with the situation in my building. That's all.
Have you noticed your thoughts or speech becoming hard for other people to follow?

No. ... I haven't. 

My thoughts are perfectly clear. I communicate just fine. I don't know why you would ask me that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your motivation or ability to function day to day since this started?

I suppose... my schedule has shifted. 

I’ve had to pull back from several of my consulting jobs recently. ... I just have to spend a lot of my week following up with the neighbors, the management office, the building staff. I have to keep track of what they're doing. 

So... no, I haven't really been settling into my normal work. I haven't touched my painting routine in a while, either. I just don't have the time for it right now with everything going on.
Has anyone close to you also come to believe that the building staff or neighbors are deliberately targeting you?

No. ... I haven't asked them. 

I don't really discuss my private affairs with other people. It's... it's my situation to manage, so I keep it to myself.
Has this belief about the building staff and neighbors been present continuously for at least one month?

Yes. ... Longer than that. 

It's been about 11 months. ... Pretty much since shortly after I moved into the new apartment.
Since this started, have you had any periods of feeling unusually depressed or unusually energized for several days at a time?

No... I wouldn't say that. 

I don't really have extreme moods like that. I'm just... dealing with the situation at hand. I haven't noticed feeling particularly depressed or overly energetic. Just focused on what needs to be done.
